title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
summary: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.

title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
summary: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
summary: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
summary: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

title: Robinhood Chain slowdown spreads from fees to trading as transactions fall more than 40%
summary: Daily activity has dropped from 10.8 million transactions to 6.2 million since mid-September even as Robinhood keeps paying network fees on customer swaps.
